profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at CACI | MS in Software Engineering at GMU
profile.summary:
An experienced software engineer with a passion for developing tools and applications that enhance the lives of my users. Whenever I see a problem, I like to utilize all the resources I have available to provide an effective solution that other people can benefit from. As a detail-oriented person, I aim to present my works with graphically pleasing designs. And with users always in mind, I create my applications with ease of access and efficiency as my priority.

Sharing knowledge in this digital, connected era is key--so I take time to generate helpful documentation for reference not just for myself, but for my team members and peers to learn something new from.

I pursued my Master's degree in Software Engineering at George Mason University where I was a previous alumnus for my Bachelors degree in Computer Science. Since my undergrad, I have been actively working and contributing to the field for years, and returned in 2023-24 to expand my knowledge based on attained experiences, as well as explore cutting edge technologies like AI and machine learning. 

My hope for the future is to further gain industry experience so that I can improve my skills and learn about other tools & languages that I can use to engineer better programs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architect and develop Spring Boot backend services using RESTful APIs, secure authentication and authorization models, and comprehensive unit and integration testing.
- Design and evolve modular, service-oriented architectures, including breaking down monolithic systems into smaller, independently deployable services to improve performance, maintainability, and release velocity.
- Lead database modernization and cloud migration efforts, recreating schemas, validating data integrity, and implementing automated tests to ensure reliability and consistency.
- Modernize and containerize backend applications to improve scalability, deployment efficiency, and operational stability across environments.
- Own the delivery of modernized application solutions and prototypes, collaborating with stakeholders and customers to align technical implementations with real-world workflows and platform requirements.
- Serve as a technical leader and mentor, providing guidance on architecture, troubleshooting complex issues, and supporting developers across multiple teams.
- Create and maintain technical documentation and onboarding resources, improving knowledge sharing, reducing ramp-up time, and enabling consistent development practices.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Spearheading the adoption of modern technologies on the existing web application, and actively working with managers to promote new, optimal solutions that save costs and time to the customers.
•	Managing a team in a project that employs Agile practices in a conversion effort to rebuild an integral, old module from backend to frontend.
•	Creating modules that improved workflow with comprehensive user-experience, and visually appealing user-interface designs.
•	Consistently educating and supporting team members in understanding React and its available libraries and creating multiple guides and videos to facilitate the learning.

positions.title: Samsung Experience Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed a mobile application that facilitated the tracking, and the check-in process for customers.
• Contributed to the store’s top ranking in the market for sales and workshop numbers by actively engaging customers.
• Consistently delivered great customer experience resulting in referrals that increases turnout and profits for the department.

positions.title: Mobile Associate
positions.description:
• Provided solutions that reduced the customer’s monthly bill by up to 50%.
• Communicated closely with leadership and collaborated with colleagues 
in achieving high sales performance in the district.

positions.title: Easy Tech Associate
positions.description:
• Delivered outstanding services that resulted to perfect scores on client experience surveys.
• Promoted organization & cleanliness that reduced preparation time to almost none for next shift workers.
